Hello! I am **Hafizul Shah**. 

I hold an M.Sc. in Physics with a background in computational materials (DFT / CASTEP, HPC environments, and structural analysis). I am currently focused on expanding into **Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI**.

This website serves as my public notebook, technical archive, and platform for sharing my views and deep-dives on computational science, technology, and career growth.
